STANZA I
Poor Esau repented too late
That once he his birth–right despised;
And sold, for a morsel of meat,
What could not too highly be prized:
How great was his anguish when told,
The blessing he sought to obtain,
Was gone with the birth–right he sold,
And none could recall it again!
Where Newton found it
Newton printed the hymn under Genesis 25:34, 16. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright. GENESIS 25:34, 16 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ GENESIS 25
